question.text: How much will Nasdaq-100 Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the difference between the percent total price return of [Nasdaq-100 Futures (NQ)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NQ%3DF/history/) and that of [S\&P 500 Futures (ES)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ES%3DF/history/) for the corresponding biweekly period, according to Yahoo Finance data.

Specifically, each subquestion will resolve as NQ\_return - ES\_return.

Returns will be calculated as follows: If P₀ is the Close price of an asset on the last trading day or half-day *before* the start of the period and P₁ is the Close price of the stock on the last trading day *of* the designated period, the percentage return will be calculated as:

$$
 \text{return} = 100 \times \frac{P1 - P0}{P0}
$$
question.fine_print:
* If ES outperforms NQ, the corresponding subquestion will resolve as a negative number.
* If Yahoo Finance delays or ceases reporting these data or if it reports them in error, Metaculus might use alternative credible sources to resolve this question.

***

For example, for the period Jun 9, 2025 - Jun 20, 2025, the subquestion would have resolved based on the following calculations:

NQ\_P₀ \= 21,789.50 (the Close price on Jun 6)

NQ\_P₁ \= 21,889.89 (the Close price on Jun 20)

NQ\_return \= 100 × (21,889.89 - 21,789.50) / 21,789.50 \= 0.4607

ES\_P₀ \= 6,006.75 (the Close price on Jun 6)

ES\_P₁ \= 6,010.21 (the Close price on Jun 20)

ES\_return \= 100 × (6,010.21 - 6,006.75) / 6,006.75 \= 0.0576

And the resolution would be 0.4607 - 0.0576 \= **0.4031** percentage points (pp).

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo's chart data for NQ=F and ES=F is the front-month December 2026 contract for each ("Nasdaq 100 Dec 26", "E-Mini S&P 500 Dec 26"). The December contracts expire around Dec 18 and trading usually rolls to March around Dec 10-11, so a roll during the window looks unlikely. [NQ](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/NQ=F?range=1mo&interval=1d), [ES](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ES=F?range=1mo&interval=1d)

- Recent daily closes (NQ / ES):

- How the period is priced: P0 is the Friday Nov 20 close and P1 is the Friday Dec 4 close. The window includes Thanksgiving (Nov 26) and a half-day on Nov 27.

## 2. Current status

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: Nasdaq Composite opened down about 1.5% versus about 1% for the S&P 500. NQ futures were down 1.4% and ES down 0.6%. Nvidia lost 13% last week, its worst week since April 2025. [TradingView/Invezz](https://www.tradingview.com/news/invezz:c2801c958094b:0-nasdaq-opens-1-5-lower-as-nvidia-earnings-and-anthropic-ipo-weigh-on-ai-stocks/), [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-16-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-oil-091631084.html)

  - VIX is about 21 and the 10-year yield 5.14%.
  - Producer prices are up 6.5% year on year.
  - A December Fed rate hike is seen as more likely.
  
  [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/nvidias-first-post-jensen-earnings-and-anthropics-ipo-what-to-watch-this-week-110000732.html)
- 2026-11-16: Anthropic's IPO (Nasdaq ticker "ANT"): 825 million shares at $70-78, a valuation of about $1.3-1.45 trillion. Pricing is Nov 18 and trading starts Nov 19. Commentators say investors may be selling other AI names to fund purchases. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/nasdaq-100-chip-stocks-fall-as-nvidia-earnings-and-anthropic-ipo-loom-1644890), [Quartz](https://qz.com/wall-street-lower-open-nvidia-anthropic-ipo-111626)
- Nasdaq-100 "fast entry" rule (in effect since May 1, 2026): a large new listing is tested at its 7th-day close (for Anthropic, about Nov 30), announced after the 10th day (about Dec 3), and added after about 15 trading days. SpaceX was added this way on July 7. I found no confirmation that the rule will apply to Anthropic. If it does, the announcement would fall inside the window, which could prompt index funds to sell existing members to make room. [Leverage Shares](https://leverageshares.com/us/insights/anthropic-nasdaq-100/), [Nasdaq.com](https://nasdaq.com/articles/spacex-quickly-entering-index-funds-will-openai-and-anthropic-do-same-after-their-ipos)

## 4. Base rates
I computed these from Yahoo weekly closes, using non-overlapping two-week periods (NQ return minus ES return, in pp).
- Last 12 months, in order: +1.97, -1.14, -0.53, +0.09, +0.09, -1.72, +0.25, +1.23, -1.00, +1.46, +3.57, +3.80, -0.20, -0.59, +3.48, -2.44, -2.99, -1.57, +2.32, -1.09, +0.45, +3.23, -0.01, -3.86 (Oct 2-16), -3.61 (Oct 16-Nov 6). The partial Nov 6-16 period is about +0.27.
- Typical size of the gap:
  - Late 2025 to early 2026: absolute gaps were mostly under 1.7pp.
  - Since about April 2026: dispersion is much higher, with a standard deviation of roughly 2.5pp and many moves of ±3-4pp.
  - NQ has moved about 1.5-2.5 times as much as ES in either direction, so the sign of the gap has mostly followed market direction.
- Trend: NQ underperformed ES by about 7.5pp over the four weeks from Oct 2 to Nov 6, as tech led the market down. NQ is about 13% below its 52-week high (31,616.5), while ES is about 5% below its high (7,897.5).
- Same window in past years: the closest match last year, Nov 21 to Dec 5, 2025, was NQ +5.87% vs ES +3.90%, a gap of **+1.97pp** (a post-selloff rebound through Thanksgiving). I did not pull exact equivalents for 2021-2024.
- Statistical baseline (12-day NQ distribution supplied with the question): p5 25,759, p50 27,666, p95 29,505, or roughly ±6-7% around the latest price. That implies the gap will usually be under ±3pp, with tails out to about ±4pp.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market on the NQ-minus-ES gap itself.
- Polymarket, "NDX close in December" (prices from the list provided; they look incoherent and illiquid, summing well above 1): <$23,500 at 0.51; $25,000-26,500 at 0.42; $26,500-28,500 at 0.43. Little usable signal.
- Kalshi: the S&P 500 Equal Weight index beating the S&P 500 in 2026 is priced at 0.93. This suggests markets expect megacap and tech underperformance for the year as a whole, which only loosely relates to this window.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Nov 17: Nvidia fiscal Q3 earnings after the close, its first without Huang. Also October retail sales.
- Nov 18: FOMC minutes and Anthropic IPO pricing.
- Nov 19: Anthropic starts trading. Also Walmart earnings and jobless claims.
- Nov 20: University of Michigan sentiment; this close sets P0.
- Nov 26-27: Thanksgiving closure and half-day, so trading will be thin.
- About Nov 30 to Dec 3: possible Nasdaq-100 fast-entry test and announcement for Anthropic (unconfirmed).
- Dec 4: November jobs report, normally the first Friday (I did not confirm the date); this close sets P1.
- Over the coming month: congressional testimony from Huang, Nvidia's general counsel and Commerce Secretary Lutnick. The Fed's December meeting probably falls after Dec 4 (date not confirmed).
- Weather is not relevant.
